repair_tech
My Lenovo G50-80 has no power. I measured +5VALW and it is 0V. The VIN is 19V. Resistance to ground on +5VALW is 8 ohm. Could a capacitor be shorted? The +3VALW is fine at 3.3V.
on: 2024-05-01, 10:30:00
expert
8 ohms on +5VALW is a definite short. Replaced C45 (22uF 6.3V) and the board powered on. I measured 480 ohm to ground after the fix. The fault was a shorted ceramic capacitor.
on: 2024-05-02, 14:00:00
